```go

### func Main

### type Report

```

Report contains the result of running a Mini-Go test suite.

#### field Report.Suite

```go

```

Suite is the package or suite name.

#### field Report.Passed

### type Result

```go
type Result struct { ... }
```

#### field Result.Name

```go

```

#### field Result.Status

#### field Result.Message
